why_not_one_block_off: Sheet 71 covers 33rd-36th, sheet 79 covers 36th-39th; 36th is the only shared street and both plates print '36TH ST.' in it. Address runs pin the block: sheet 71's north frontage of 36th reads 1402 1404 1406 1408 1410 1412 | 1414 1416 1418 1420 1422 1424 (its Avenue M 1/2 to Avenue N block, split by the 20' alley) with the Avenue N 1/2 corner numbers 3524 3526 3528 3530 3532 running north, then 1502 1504 1506 1508 1510 east of Avenue N; sheet 79's south frontage reads 1501 1503 1505 1507 1509 1511 | 1513 1515 1517 1519 1521 1523 (its Avenue N to Avenue N 1/2 block) with the Avenue N 1/2 corner numbers 3533 3535 / 3601 3602 3603 3604. The M1/2-N=1400, N-N1/2=1500 chain matches across the seam, so the two frontages face each other across the same street. One street north on sheet 71 is 35th (faces 2392/2633), one south on sheet 79 is 37th (faces 1246/1489); neither is shared. Detection's candidates (71: 3140/1951/762; 79: 758/1997/3237) were discarded. Sheet 71 draws only the NORTH half of 36th: it prints '40'' twice between its block-face rule at y=3658 and its south neat line at y=3779, i.e. the neat line IS the street centre-line, so a_native = 3779 (not 3658, which is the block face). Sheet 79 draws the full 80' corridor and prints '80'' in it; its faces are y=104 and y=344 -> 224.
